```yaml
name: Validate OpenAPI Specs

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate OpenAPI spec ${{ matrix.spec }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        spec:
          - openapi.yml
          - openapi-edge.yml
          - openapi-hyperloop.yml
          - packages/envd/spec/envd.yaml
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Redocly CLI
        run: npm install -g @redocly/cli

      - name: Create minimal Redocly config
        run: |
          echo "rules: {}" > redocly.yaml

      - name: Lint spec
        run: |
          redocly lint ${{ matrix.spec }} --config redocly.yaml
```
